changelog: Trade journal: 'While it's open' and 'After close' now each show their own set of feeling chips instead of both reusing the same nine Before-Entry options -- Before-Entry is completely unchanged.

While Open: Calm trusting the plan, Anxious about the stop, Hoping it turns around, Greedy want to add or move the target, Wanting out early, Tempted to move the stop, Checking the chart constantly, Bored impatient for it to finish, Fear of giving back profit.

After Close: Accepting it was the plan, Relieved, Satisfied followed the plan, Frustrated or angry, Urge to revenge trade, Regret closed too early, Regret held too long, Overconfident after a win, Flat or numb, Eager to jump back in right away.
Every chip keeps its info icon with a one-line explanation, same chip look as before -- no redesign, no new dependency.

A feeling already saved on an existing trade under the old shared list (e.g. 'Vengeful' on a During check-in, from before this release) still shows, pre-selected, as an extra chip on that trade -- labelled 'from an older list' rather than dropped or silently relabeled.
No change to Before-Entry's own list, to trades.emotion_tag, or to any already-saved trade's data. No migration -- both storage columns were already free text with no fixed-list constraint.
release_notes: Trade journal emotion taxonomy split per-stage (includes/emotion_states.php, js/trades.js, modals/trade-modal.php, index.php) -- Phase 0 investigation (reported separately to Acrob before implementation) confirmed trade_journal.emotion_code/trade_checkins.emotion_code are both already free-text VARCHAR(30) with no server-side whitelist, so no migration was needed or done. New codes are brand-new identifiers, never aliased onto an old shared-list code even where conceptually similar, so Before-Entry's own labels/descriptions (unchanged) never had to move. Old stored values are resolved via a new allEmotionCodes()/window.ALL_EMOTION_CODES merged lookup and rendered as a real extra chip, pre-selected, in the owning phase's grid -- never dropped, never bulk-rewritten. Confirmed ReviewEngineController's only emotion-aware insight rules read trades.emotion_tag (frozen since v3.11.0, nothing writes it anymore) rather than trade_journal/trade_checkins, so this release doesn't touch what Review Engine reads either way -- flagged to Acrob as a separate pre-existing gap, out of scope here. Did not add a second 'Did I follow my plan?' field per Acrob's instruction -- the existing good_process Yes/No already asks this. Verified with a new standalone Playwright driver, tools/ui-harness/drive-v3300.mjs, which gets its embedded option-list globals by actually invoking the real includes/emotion_states.php/journal_taxonomy.php functions via a generated one-shot PHP script (not a hand-copied snapshot), so it can't drift from what index.php actually embeds: 15/15 assertions covering the three lists' contents/order/disjointness, info-icon descriptions, an old During value and an old After-Close value each still showing as a pre-selected extra chip with the 'older list' note, emotionLabel() resolving an old code via the read-only panel's own code path, the note clearing once a current option is picked, and a newly saved After-Close code round-tripping through collectTradeJournal() and showing selected again on reopen. php -l and node --check pass clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite (13 pre-existing drivers + this new one) passes.
